ITEM 1 | Cubed pale golden-tan pieces, roughly 2-3 cm each, with crisp browned edges and seasoned flecks on the surface, soft interior, dry matte sheen, arranged in a cluster on the upper-left of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Thin rounds and half-moons of bright orange carrot, about 0.5 cm thick, glossy and slightly moist, with a few pieces overlapping in a fan shape on the upper-right of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Sliced dark reddish-brown meat, about 0.5 cm thick strips, with seared browned exterior and pink-red center, slightly glossy and juicy, lying beside a bed of green leafy stems on the middle-left of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Cubed dark purple-skinned vegetable pieces, roughly 2 cm, with pale cream flesh showing at cut faces, some browned and charred edges, slightly oily sheen, scattered on the lower-right of the plate next to the carrots | 75
ITEM 5 | Thin green stems and leafy greens, dark green with wilted texture, partly under the meat and between the potato and vegetable pieces, slightly glossy | 15
ITEM 6 | Small dark reddish-brown wilted bits, tiny piece, sitting on top of the potatoes near the upper center of the plate | 5
